select * from ( SELECT bda.bookset_id as booksetId,/**账套代码**/ deal.trade_id as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ deal.finprod_id as finprodId,/**金融产品id**/ deal.finprod_type as finprodType,/**金融产品类型**/ prd.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr,/**金融产品简称**/ bda.busi_table as busiTable,/**业务表**/ deal.inv_aim as orgDealInvaim,/**原始交易的投资目的**/ bdone.inv_aim as assetInvaim,/**一般.资产.投资目的**/ bdtwo.inv_aim as secDetailTypeInvaim,/**一般.细分类.投资目的**/ bdThree.inv_aim as specialInvaim,/**特殊.资产.投资目的**/ nvl(bdThree.inv_aim,nvl(bdtwo.inv_aim,bdone.inv_aim)) as changeInvaim /**最终投资目：优先取的顺序：特殊.资产.投资目的 > 一般.细分类.投资目的 > 一般.资产.投资目的**/
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal /**金融产品交易表**/ INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT prd on prd.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id and prd.finprod_type = deal.finprod_type /**关联标的类金融产品**/ INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE pty ON pty.finprod_id = prd.finprod_id /**关联金融产品分类表**/ INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING bda ON bda.busi_no = deal.trade_id /**关联入账信息表 **/ INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN bbp ON bbp.bookset_id = bda.bookset_id /**关联账套估值方案表**/ LEFT JOIN ( /**关联估值方案明细,资产关联（取起息日离交易日最近的一条）**/ SELECT a.scheme_detail_id, a.scheme_id, a.Sec_Detail_Type, a.inv_aim, a.vdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.scheme_id ORDER BY a.vdate DESC ) AS rn /**以方案代码分组排序**/ FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL a WHERE a.sec_type= '01' AND a.Sec_Detail_Type is null AND #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate )bdone on bdone.scheme_id = bbp.scheme_id and bdone.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( /**关联估值方案明细,细分类关联（取起息日离交易日最近的一条）**/ SELECT a.scheme_detail_id, a.scheme_id, a.Sec_Detail_Type, a.inv_aim, a.vdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.scheme_id,a.sec_detail_type ORDER BY a.vdate DESC ) AS rn /**以方案代码和细分类分组排序**/ FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL a WHERE a.sec_type= '01' AND #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate )bdtwo ON bdtwo.scheme_id = bbp.scheme_id AND bdtwo.sec_detail_type = pty.type_1 and bdtwo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL_SPECIAL bdThree ON bdThree.Scheme_Id = bbp.scheme_id AND bdThree.Finprod_Id = deal.finprod_id AND deal.trade_date >= bdThree.vdate AND nvl(bdThree.mdate,to_date('2099-12-31','yyyy-mm-dd')) >= deal.trade_date /**关联特殊资产估值方案明细,资产关联(已确认区间只有一条，故无需过滤)**/
WHERE 1=1 AND deal.finprod_type = 'F01' /***金融产品交易类型：债券**/ AND bda.bookset_id = #{bookset,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**账套**/ AND deal.trade_date = #{booksetDate,jdbcType=DATE} /**账套日期过滤交易日期**/ ) a where a.orgDealInvaim! = a.changeInvAim and a.changeInvAim is not null

SELECT bda.bookset_id as booksetId,/**账套代码**/ deal.finprod_id as finprodId,/**金融产品id**/ deal.finprod_type as finprodType,/**金融产品类型**/ prd.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr,/**金融产品简称**/ deal.trade_id as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ deal.trade_date as tradeDate, /**交易日**/ bda.busi_table as busiTable,/**业务表**/ bbp.scheme_id as schemeId,/**方案代码**/ pty.type_1 as secDetailType,/**资产细分类**/ deal.inv_aim as orgDealInvaim /**原始交易的投资目的**/
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal /**金融产品交易表**/ INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT prd on prd.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id and prd.finprod_type = deal.finprod_type /**关联标的类金融产品**/ INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE pty ON pty.finprod_id = prd.finprod_id /**关联金融产品分类表**/ INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING bda ON bda.busi_no = deal.trade_id /**关联入账信息表 **/ INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN bbp ON bbp.bookset_id = bda.bookset_id /**关联账套估值方案表**/ INNER JOIN BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo ON todo.bookset_id = bda.bookset_id AND todo.bookset_date = deal.trade_date /**关联批处理待处理任务表，过滤交易数据**/ WHERE 1=1 AND deal.finprod_type = 'F01' /***金融产品交易类型：债券**/ AND todo.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND todo.BOOKSET_DATE = #{booksetdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND todo.TASK_ID = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND todo.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} ORDER BY bda.bookset_id,deal.finprod_id,deal.trade_date,deal.trade_id ASC

SELECT b.inv_aim FROM ( SELECT a.*,row_number() over() rownum FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL a WHERE a.sec_type = '01' AND a.Sec_Detail_Type is null AND a.scheme_id = #{schemeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate order by a.vdate desc ) b WHERE rownum=1

SELECT b.inv_aim FROM ( SELECT a.*,row_number() over() rownum FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL a WHERE a.sec_type = '01' AND a.scheme_id = #{schemeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.sec_detail_type = #{secDetailType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.vdate order by a.vdate desc ) b WHERE rownum=1
